{{Search|movie character|Secret ID|Trainer ID number}} {{CharInfobox| color={{water color}} | corecolor={{water color light}} | bordercolor={{water color dark}} | name=Sid | jname=ショウタ| tmname=Shōta | slogan=no | image=Sid.png | size=100px | caption=Sid | gender=Male | hometown=[[South City]] | trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} | region=[[Hoenn]] | relatives=Unknown | trainer=yes | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=M07 | epname=Destiny Deoxys | enva=[[List of English voice actors|Matthew Charles]] | java=[[Makoto Higo]] | }} '''Sid''' (Japanese: '''ショウタ''' ''Shōta'') is a major character who appeared in the {{pkmn|movie}} ''[[M07|Destiny Deoxys]]''. ==In the movies== [[File:Sid May M07.png|thumb|250px|left|Sid's affection towards May]] ===History=== ====''[[M07|Destiny Deoxys]]''==== Sid, along with his friends [[Rafe]], {{OBP|Rebecca|M07}}, [[Audrey and Kathryn]], came to [[LaRousse City]] to compete at the {{OBP|Battle Tower|Generation III}}. While there, he met {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Once he saw {{an|May}}, he became smitten with her, and throughout the movie he did his best to garner her attention, but with little success. Once at the Battle Tower, Sid and Rafe were assigned a Double Battle against Ash and [[Tory Lund]] using their {{p|Blastoise}} and {{p|Blaziken}} against [[Ash's Pikachu]] and {{AP|Torkoal}} (who was borrowed by Tory at the time). Thanks to Sid's Blastoise, he and Rafe won the match. Later, {{OBP|Deoxys|M07}} arrived and unleashed numerous clones to abduct every human and Pokémon in sight, and when one of the clones went after May, Sid sacrificed himself to save her, and was taken prisoner by Deoxys. Thanks to the efforts of Ash and his friends, Sid and the others were saved. When energy needed to be restored to the city, Sid helped by having his Blastoise use {{m|Hydro Pump}} to move the windmills. Even after everything was resolved, May still refused to give him a hug. ====''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]''==== Sid briefly reappeared in a montage in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', which chronicled the preceding nine {{pkmn|movie}}s. ===Character=== Sid comes off as a jolly guy who is willing to act in times of need. He also has a crush on {{an|May}} and tries his best to win her over. Unfortunately for him, May does not reciprocate his feelings, and treats him more as a friend. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sid |pkmn=Blastoise |type1=Water |img=Sid Blastoise.png |epnum=M07 |epname=Destiny Deoxys |vajp=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Ryokichi Takahashi |vaen= |desc={{p|Blastoise}} is the only Pokémon of Sid's [[party]] shown in ''[[M07|Destiny Deoxys]]''. It first appeared in the {{Gdis|Battle Tower|III}} where Sid used Blastoise in the battle against [[Tory Lund|Tory]] and {{Ash}} and easily won. When all of the Trainers tried to manually move the windmills, Blastoise tried to move it with its {{m|Hydro Pump}} with the help of other {{type|Water}} moves. Blastoise's known moves are {{m|Hydro Pump}}, {{m|Rapid Spin}}, {{m|Skull Bash}}, and {{m|Bubble}}.}} ===Achievements=== ====Pokémon competitions==== Sid has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Battle Tower]]- {{tt|Unknown|Sid and Rafe won the first round and consequently moved on to the next.
